## Quantum "Hello World"

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| fig-align: center
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
qc.h(0)
qc.cx(0, 1)
qc.measure_all()
qc.draw('mpl') # Draw Bell state
```
